claim: Make CB.Belief.Store.write persist the belief list as one file per node (write changed, delete removed) instead of rewriting a single array, and choose the multi-node write atomicity strategy: per-file tmp+rename, temp-dir swap, or accept non-transactional multi-file writes at local/single-writer scale (the constraint recorded in cb:b554).

evidence.detail: Discharged 2026-07-06: Store.write diffs the belief list against the on-disk directory - new nodes written before changed ones (a crash mid-supersession leaves a duplicate-claim conflict preflight detects, never a dangling superseded_by), byte-identical files skipped so untouched nodes never churn, removed nodes deleted, duplicate ids refused before any write. Atomicity strategy chosen per the cb:b554 constraint: per-file tmp+rename (CB.JSON.write_atomic_raw), non-transactional across nodes, accepted at local single-writer scale.
